verdict.rationale: Portkey's docs describe budget limits on API keys, set as spend or token thresholds, that automatically block further usage once reached. Budgets can reset weekly and send threshold notifications. Budgets and rate limits are also available at org and workspace level, which roughly maps to the team scope. Missing for 10: explicit per-user budget enforcement, a team-specific scope beyond workspaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration that hard limits are enforced.
